To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
work-family management practices at the organization level can have a beneficial influence on employees’ family lives.
Workplace organizational support was associated with positive work affect, which in turn was associated with family life enrichment among women.

(a) work-family enrichment theory is supported by the results of this study; (b) the indirect effect of organizational support for work-family issues is significant for women, but not for men; (c) positive affect at work is a significant mediator of the effect of organizational support on family outcomes for women, but only marginally so for men; and (d) positive affect at home is a significant mediator for men, but only marginaly so for women.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the positive effects of work on the family.
the extent to which work resources and positive affect at the workplace can be beneficial for the family life.
the extent to which resources and positive affect are associated with family enrichment for both partners in a dual earner couple.

work-family enrichment is a positive phenomenon that can occur when resources generated in the work domain are transferred to the family domain and positively impact the family domain.
